summary: Likely wear out in Motors - Bearings, Motors - Encoder / Resolver. Start with the troubleshooting steps below and confirm before replacing parts.

predicted.rationale: MP-Series servo motor returns are dominated by bearing and encoder wear.

procedure.title: Motors - Worn / End of Life
steps: Check for audible or vibration signs of bearing wear before disassembly.
Measure shaft runout and bearing play against the motor's service-manual tolerance.
If an encoder/resolver is implicated, verify signal integrity and mounting alignment before replacing the sensor itself.
Replace bearings as a matched set, not individually, and re-grease per the motor's lubrication spec.
Re-test running current draw and vibration signature against baseline after reassembly.
